subject.title: Apply design-system composer to app chat UI

question: Should the composer redesign and relocation of read-aloud and tool-call controls into Settings land together in this PR?
rationale: The branch changes both the composer's presentation and where users control chat behavior, so implementation correctness alone cannot establish the intended permanent UX boundary.

options.title: Approve the combined UX
options.body: Keep both parts together after replacing the English fallback values in all four non-English locales.

options.title: Split control relocation
options.body: Land a composer-focused change separately and preserve the current inline controls until the Settings placement receives explicit approval.

recommendation.title: Approve the combined UX
recommendation.body: Keep both parts together after replacing the English fallback values in all four non-English locales.

likelyOwner.reason: As a project creator and adjacent Windows UX owner, he is the best available routing candidate for the cross-surface product decision.
